EURUSD.state: Price is moving lower, but the wider picture is still mixed. The current move has pressure behind it without becoming a clean, sustained downtrend.
paragraphs:
CURRENT PICTURE
Price has fallen for 6 Renko bricks in a row. The move is real, but the wider picture is still mixed rather than a clean downtrend. Balance/chop is still high at 94.5, while clean continuation is only 19.1. The latest readings also changed only slightly: continuation 34.3 → 33.7 and balance/chop 94.0 → 94.5. In plain terms, price moved down faster than the wider picture changed.

STRUCTURE & PRESSURE
The confirmed swing pattern is lower highs and lower lows. The latest confirmed low is 1.14550 and the latest confirmed high is 1.16400. LR150-S8 is down at 1.16086, above price. SAR is also above price at 1.14808. Opposing wick pressure is low and stable, moving from 0.7726 to 0.6019. The weak point is consistency: recent runs keep flipping direction, so the move is not yet clean.

PATTERN & VOLATILITY
Bollinger Bands are expanded but contracting. Price is below the middle band at 1.14295. The lower band is 1.13458 and the upper band is 1.15132, so volatility is still broad even as the bands begin to narrow. A developing bull Developing Bat pattern is still active, with D at 1.13900. It points against the current down move, so it is a possible counter-move signal rather than confirmation that price has reversed.

WHAT WOULD CHANGE THIS
The picture becomes clearer when one side holds control for longer, with more consistent runs and steadier timing. A stable sideways range would also replace the current mixed behavior. Until one of those changes appears, another isolated move up or down is not enough to call a lasting trend.
